title: Prove exact coarse-output error for a refined dirty helper (no κ)
body:
For the fixed four-call ABI H+=a*x; Y+=O(H); H-=a*x; Y-=O(H), with O(H)=floor(3H/2^b+1/2), prove the exact worst error ceil(|3a-2^b|B/2^b) coarse output cells and its integer-a minimum ceil(B/2^b). Source/output spacing stays fixed while the arbitrary dirty helper is refined. The inverse SUBTRACTS THE SAME rounded O(H); independently rounding a negative increment is different at half ties.

This is a **quantitative source/interface corollary** of Ali Romman's PR1135 residue/four-call method and Nick Petalas's PR6666 exact-dyadic odd-scalar approximation, taking6666's released fixed-grid question. The general four-shear identity, same-grid obstruction and approximation method are predecessor work. It is not an all-algorithm lower bound, physical caller, or complete implementation of6666. [Written proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e6c76ebf56fcd968c1383f00688152114f9dc79/research/coarse-output-dirty-reader-minimax/PROOF.md), [validation/corrections](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e6c76ebf56fcd968c1383f00688152114f9dc79/research/coarse-output-dirty-reader-minimax/VALIDATION.md), [advance claim/handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19381560).

Validation:
- Both independent mathematical outputs agree on every441 complete signed histogram/extrema/witness row and63 declared-window minima (454279 visits). b0..8, sevenB bounds, sevena coefficients, every helper phase and integer source input. Window optimizer lists are NOT all global optimizers; the written proof carries every parameter/global-minimum quantifier.
- Managed CPython3.12.14 strict normal/optimized primary and oracle, explicit oracle primary-data comparison, registered replay, committed bytes/modes/source history, official export/input integrity, and four Git-free read-only empty-PATH cold commands pass.
-26 oracle normal/optimized rejection commands and15 additional root isolated mutation cases reject. Static proof/implementation review is separate AI evidence, not human/kernel acceptance.
- First primary Python passed but time-l instrumentation exited1 on a denied sysctl; preserved separately. Original oracle blind-first used3.9.6, then managed3.12.14. Review reproduced a duplicate-key acceptance defect, fixed its strict loader and corrected draft registration to include --check-primary. Both original and final oracle source/receipts remain separately preserved; the entire mathematical projection matches both blind firsts, SHA256 f64ca94e6287f2bd50023cc20c28ce91ca2222b0c7a5c98e4e1dd9a6f5cb3abf. Do not read this as unchanged first oracle code/full receipt.
